red__make_nb_cube_stokes.pro


Routines

top source red::make_nb_cube_stokes

SST pipeline

red::make_nb_cube_stokes, wcfile, ashifts=ashifts [, clips=array], cmap_fwhm=float, cshift_mean=cshift_mean, date_avg_array=date_avg_array, date_beg_array=date_beg_array, date_end_array=date_end_array, exp_array=exp_array, fileassoc=fileassoc, filename=filename, fitpref_time=fitpref_time, fnumsum_array=fnumsum_array, fov_mask=fov_mask [, /nearest] [, /noremove_periodic], nsum_array=nsum_array, nthreads=nthreads, pertuningfiles=pertuningfiles, pertuningstates=pertuningstates [, /redemodulate], remove_smallscale=remove_smallscale, sexp_array=sexp_array [, tiles=array], wbcor=wbcor, wbfileassoc=wbfileassoc, wbfilename=wbfilename [, /wbsave], wcs=wcs

Make a de-rotated and de-stretched time-series FITS data cube with Stokes images based on momfbd-restored narrow-band images.

It reads all temporal de-rotation and de-stretching information from the wideband cube produced by companion method make_wb_cube. Cavity maps are added to the WCS metadata as distortions to the wavelength coordinate.

Parameters

wcfile in type=string

The name of the corrected WB cube file.

FWHM in pixels of kernel used for smoothing the cavity map.
